verses.text: Vying for more distracted you pl
But no! You pl will come to know.
Once again: But no! You pl will come to know.
But no! If only you pl knew with the knowledge of certitude:
Then you pl will certainly see it with the eye of certitude.
Then, on that day, you pl will certainly be asked about (worldly) bliss.

footnotes.1: Qira’at: Ibn ‘Amer and Al-Kesa’i read it as: “…you will certainly be shown purgatory.”
